review.boss-rug-pull-baron: Human ringmaster read: top hat, epaulettes, open red long coat, cane; clean limb deformation; mild sleeve stretch in the arms-raised tell and super-tell.
review.boss-51-foreman: Bearded heavy in the Whiteout armour, face visible under a gold hard hat with lamp, furnace pack with stacks, steam hammer right, owner minigun on the left forearm; clean deformation.
review.boss-lockkeeper: Riot Enforcer body with a wide-brim hat, open green cloak to the knee, chest chains and padlocks, rust great key, winch drum and crank on the shoulder; grounded after the stray shield fragment was removed.
review.firstPassRejected: Gated nearest-bone skinning tore the torso into wings on every arm move, the palette atlas sampled empty rows (black gear), the hard hat covered the face, and a shield fragment floated the Lockkeeper; all fixed before these renders.
